== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Luke's Bionic Hand]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Luke's Bionic Hand (Errata)]] shares the [[Luke's Bionic Hand]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
